primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The Modified Naughton Exercise Treadmill Test was employed in this study. Exercise Treadmill Test 3 (ETT-3) was performed during the last 2 hours of the 20-hour infusion of study drug or placebo. Baseline Exercise Treadmill Test (ETT-B) was performed prior to dosing.
